;Disasters and accidents
*At least 51 people are killed when a bus traveling from the [[Kenya]]n capital [[Nairobi]] to [[Kisumu]] veers off the road and overturns. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45807969 (BBC)]
*Three people were killed and houses were damaged after a magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck off [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/shallow-60-magnitude-quake-hits-off-indonesias-java-usgs (''The Straits Times'')]
*At least five people died and 30 were injured  when a passenger train derailed in the north [[India]]n state of [[Uttar Pradesh]]. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2018/10/10/bus-crash-kills-42-in-kenya-train-accident-kills-5-in-india/ (''Cyprus Mail'')]
*Four people are killed and 20 others are injured when an apartment building collapses in [[Manama]], [[Bahrain]]. [http://gulfbusiness.com/least-four-killed-building-collapses-bahrain/ (''Gulf Business'')]
*[[2018 Haiti earthquake]]
** The death toll of a magnitude 5.9 earthquake that struck [[Haiti]] rises to 17. [https://www.odt.co.nz/news/world/17-killed-haiti-quake (''Otago Daily Times'')]
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Michael]] strengthens to a "potentially catastrophic" [[list of Category 4 Atlantic hurricanes|Category 4]] hurricane and makes landfall on the [[Florida Panhandle]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/10/10/656052881/hurricane-michael-an-extremely-dangerous-category-4-storm-heads-toward-florida (NPR)] [http://fortune.com/2018/10/10/hurricane-michael-florida-landfall/ (''Fortune'')]
**A man in [[Greensboro, Florida]] is killed by a tree that crashed through his home, becoming the first reported death from the storm in the United States. Later, a child is killed by a falling tree in [[Seminole County, Georgia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45818960 (BBC)]
**The storm causes power outages to 550,000 customers in [[Florida]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], and [[Alabama]], and 375,000 people in 22 counties have been ordered to evacuate. [https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/2018-10-10-hurricane-michael-impacts-florida-gulf-coast (The Weather Channel)]
**Heavy rain and strong winds from Michael are expected in [[the Carolinas]], Georgia, and [[Virginia]] on Thursday. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2018/10/10/hurricane-michael-could-become-strongest-record-strike-florida-panhandle-wednesday/?utm_term=.988544e06c34 (''The Washington Post'')]

;International relations
*The [[Media of Turkey|Turkish newspaper]] ''[[Sabah (newspaper)|Sabah]]'' names the 15-member [[Saudi Arabia]]n intelligence team allegedly involved in the disappearance of Saudi journalist [[Jamal Khashoggi]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-politics-dissident-turkey/turkish-newspaper-names-15-saudis-in-khashoggi-case-idUSKCN1MK0J0?feedType=RSS&feedName=worldNews (Reuters)]
*Venezuelan President [[Nicolás Maduro]] announces in a public broadcast that the United States President [[Donald Trump]] has sent an order to assassinate him. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/10/venezuela-maduro-planning-assassinate-181012062654843.html (Al Jazeera)]
